status: Dated development analysis plan, frozen before the new controlled external predictions; previous benchmark findings are known. This is not prospective registration.
primary_development_reference: majority; an aggregation sensitivity definition, not expert adjudication
scale_comparisons: Smallest versus full separately within each source, architecture and training schedule; DenseNet-121 at 20000 actual updates is the principal controlled comparison.

bootstrap.unit: image identifier; patient independence remains unverified
bootstrap.pairing: identical multinomial image weights for all model, finding and reference comparisons
bootstrap.training_seeds: average the three paired seed-specific contrasts; report between-seed sample SD separately
bootstrap.intervals: 95% and 97.5% percentile intervals. The two primary matched-source contrasts receive 97.5% intervals; all development analyses remain exploratory.

calibration_scope: All 18 matched-update DenseNet-121 models; four findings and three reader reference policies. Other architectures and schedules are evaluated for discrimination and the separately frozen threshold strategy.
source_calibration: Use each model's fixed source validation set with the frozen observed binary labels. The matched-update final checkpoint is selected without validation-performance selection. Retain source label selection limitations.
sampling_seeds: 71000 through 71019, nested within each repetition and identical across methods/models

logistic.negative_slope: retain, identify and report; ranking reversal remains possible
logistic.nonfit: retain as an explicit failed attempt; no fallback fit

probability_endpoints: Brier score, ECE (15 equal-width bins) and Brier skill against calibration-sample constant prevalence; intercept/slope of the fitted recalibration map are reported separately from external calibration diagnostics. Repeated identical raw/source metrics are paired comparators, not independent estimates.
source_threshold: Empirical 90% sensitivity on observed positive source-validation labels; external sensitivity/specificity on exactly the same 12000 development-assessment images, separately for each reader definition.
interpretation: Clinical scenario: supplementary pleural-effusion review flags while all images receive routine interpretation. Neither the nominal 90% research target nor these public benchmark results establish hospital workload, patient outcomes or a new neural architecture. The existing order-statistic strategy is evaluated as an established method, not claimed as a new algorithm.
